notes: 0.3.21: The Add Card price screen now works like the card panel: TCGplayer and eBay logos as link-outs, Benchmark price above the number with a plain why line instead of engine codes, eBay sales in the receipts with each row opening its listing, Pick the sales so you can set aside the ones that are not your card, and a Current price beside the Benchmark so you can add a card at your own number. Benchmark no longer publishes a listing floor as a price: a card with no sales says so and shows what it is listed from. When a card has eBay sales but no TCGplayer sales, the price now comes from those sales instead of the ask book. A slab cert that does not resolve to a card says so in plain words. The release script no longer redeploys the catalog worker for nothing. Every Accept, typed price, Use Benchmark and lot price is now logged for the admin; nothing changes on your screens.
